items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: But because Sally Klein threw him in, on Vegas, he says, over there, he says, he lost all of the salary, the band there...

ctx.x: Well, Ted Lewis hired good musicians, he should take that out of the house. He really did that.

Well, sometimes when he came in later on with the bands there, sometimes some of them weren't too good, you know. He didn't care much then. The only thing is, but he still loved to gamble, you know. He went over there. He held up the show for about 45 minutes one night. He was shooting dice in the one, two, three across the street from Roosevelt, and they sent for him over there, come on, the show's coming on. He said, wait a minute, I've got to make this eight. He went that eight and the shower door, and his…
Well you played with these bands when they came through. Did you travel with any of them? No, no, no.
